text:
jonathan: Postmortem follow-up for Ridgeway/FinOptics peering incident — want explicit owners, short timelines, and a persistent tracker for the three remediation streams: mitigation, protocol fix, and post-incident audit/runbook. Who can pick these up?

clare: I will take mitigation (rate limiting + targeted faileover). Plan to test in prod-cage canary by Thu morning.

aditya: I'll support clare for the test harness and add automatic rollback hooks. ETA for harness: Mon 0900 PT.

sylvie: I'll own the protocol-level fix (race on the SYN/SYN-ACK path at our edge). Aim to have a patch + regression tests by next sprint; need a Wed canary slot against the customer's staging image.

jonathan: Good. Let's map concrete deliverables for tracking: M1 = mitigation config + smoke validation, P1 = edge patch + unit/reg tests, R1 = runbook + alerting thresholds + customer ops notes.

maria: Creating tasks now: RF-461 (M1), RF-462 (P1), RF-463 (R1). Assigning M1->clare, P1->sylvie, R1->aditya. Linking to PM-1930 postmortem.

clare: Mitigation diff (preview):``` 
# enable aggressive peer ingress shaping
edge.peer.shaper.enabled = true
edge.peer.shaper.rate = 75/s
edge.peer.shaper.window = 10s
``` 
Plan: apply to edge-rack-3 for a 1h canary during low traffic window and watch handshake_latency and connection_reset_rate.

aditya: I'll wire an alert: handshake_failure_rate > 0.4% for 5m -> page eng-oncall and auto-revert shaper on sustained spike. Will add to RF-461.

sylvie: Request: can FinOptics staging image be made available Wed 08:00 PT? I want to run the patch there prior to internal canary. If yes, I'll open a PR for review.

jonathan: Maria, please ask the account team to confirm staging access. Also we should add a cross-customer audit item — we've seen similar asymmetric NAT + onprem setups causing resets across 2 other customers.

maria: Noted. Adding cross-customer audit to RF-463 backlog and pinging acct team for staging access. Tickets created and linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-1930 -> RF-461/462/463.

aditya: I started a small simulation to reproduce the asymmetric NAT behavior (intermittent path change + delayed ACK). Will attach logs in RF-461.

clare: Quick smoke plan: 1) deploy shaper to edge-rack-3, 2) run 2k synthetic handshakes with NAT churn, 3) monitor KV cache hit ratio and 95th p90 latency, 4) revert if connection_reset_rate increases > 20% relative.

sylvie: Draft PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge/pull/2228 — includes jittering of the retransmit timer and a small state-machine change to avoid double-cleanup on delayed packets. Request reviews from @clare and @jonathan.

ops-bot: Canary window reserved -> 2026-04-08T03:00Z on edge-rack-3 (job id: canary-9911)

jonathan: Timeline recap: M1 (clare) canary Thu; P1 (sylvie) patch + staging Wed; R1 (aditya) runbook + alerts Mon 0900 PT. Maria to track. Weekly Wed sync from me 10:00 PT until closure. Short updates: status / blocker / next step.

maria: Calendar invite added. Tickets assigned: RF-461, RF-462, RF-463.

aditya: Status Tue: sim harness reproduces the reset pattern with NAT churn. Attaching sample trace to RF-461.

clare: Status Wed 02:30Z: shaper applied to edge-rack-3 canary, running synthetic handshakes. Initial results: handshake_failure_rate down 35%, KV cache steady. Continuing for 60m.

sylvie: Reviewing telemetry and the draft PR. Will run the staging image test Wed 08:00 PT if acct confirms.

jonathan: Important: if M1 reduces failures we proceed to audit stage. If not, we escalate to hotfix and pause canary. Keep updates concise.

clare: Canary complete: handshakes synthetic run shows improvement, real-customer traffic saw small drop in p95 but no spike in reset rate. Rolling to small internal canary next.

aditya: I put the automation for auto-revert under RF-461; alert thresholds in RF-463.

sylvie: Staging test passed. PR link above updated with test artifacts. Asking for final approvals.

jonathan: Thanks. We'll keep this thread as the single source for weekly status. Closing note: add a metric to the console dashboards for asymmetric_nat_indicator so we can proactively detect susceptible customers.

maria: Done — dashboard card requested in RF-463. Closing for today. :white_check_mark:
